name: Sark
facts: Self-governing part of the Bailiwick of Guernsey
King Charles III, as Duke of Normandy

flag.description: A white field with the red cross of St George and a red canton in the upper hoist bearing two gold lions, one above the other.
flag.symbolism: The two gold lions come from the arms of the Duchy of Normandy, recalling Sark's Norman heritage, while the cross of St George reflects its ties to the English Crown.

hook: Sark is England's cross with a red corner patch where two gold Norman lions prowl, one above the other.
trivia: The flag was designed in 1938 for the Dame of Sark, Sibyl Hathaway, and flown for decades before it was formally granted in 2020.
Cars are banned on Sark's roads; islanders get around by bicycle, tractor and horse-drawn carriage.
